steps.text: In a bowl, whisk together the eggs and milk until well combined. Season with salt and pepper.
Heat oil in a non-stick skillet over medium heat.
Add the diced bell peppers and onions to the skillet and sauté for about 2-3 minutes until they start to soften.
Add the diced tomatoes to the skillet and cook for another 1-2 minutes.
Pour the egg mixture over the vegetables in the skillet. Let it cook for a minute without stirring.
Using a spatula, gently stir the eggs and vegetables together, scrambling them until the eggs are cooked to your desired consistency.
Sprinkle the shredded cheddar cheese over the scrambled eggs and continue to cook for another minute until the cheese is melted.
Remove the skillet from heat and serve the breakfast scramble hot.
